question: While planning an approved PAS DEFT run, explain what happens after a long pool_embed stage is backgrounded and you post a progress update. May you end the turn and rely on a future poll to resume the loop? This is planning only: do not run commands or tools.
ground_truth: Attached monitoring is the default. A progress update is not a final response. The driving agent must keep the same turn alive, poll the stage's durable status with an explicit terminal condition, finalize and commit it, re-audit, and immediately execute the single next action until the whole bounded loop reaches COMPLETE, terminal FAILED, or INVALID. A final response ends monitoring and no future poll can wake an ended turn. Detach is allowed only on explicit user request or a genuine runtime limitation, in which case provide the exact durable audit/resume command and do not promise unattended continuation.
expected_behavior: States that attached monitoring is enabled by default and keeps the driving turn alive while the run is nonterminal
Treats progress updates as in-progress commentary rather than final responses
Uses terminal-condition polling, then finalize, commit, audit, and immediate continuation to the audit-selected next action
Does not claim that a timer or future poll can resume an ended chat turn
Allows detach only when explicitly requested or forced by a runtime limitation, with an exact durable audit/resume command and no unattended-monitoring claim
Does not run commands or tools
